allowSame.rsa.lblQInv: qInv is a camelCase variable-name abbreviation (like dP/dQ elsewhere on this page), not a natural-language word — kept identical in every language, the same treatment this project already gives gcd/mod notation.
allowSame.rsa.thBit: 'bit' is spelled identically in Dutch, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese and European Portuguese — genuine cognate, the standard computing term in all seven languages (Italian added by quick task 261002-c77, Polish added by quick task 261002-fmi, Brazilian and European Portuguese added by quick task 261002-jh4).
allowSame.rsa.thExpression: French 'expression' is spelled identically to English — genuine cognate.
allowSame.rsa.crtDirectVsLine: French 'direct' is spelled identically to English — genuine cognate (kept as the natural French word for this formula label).

allowLiteral.eve-factor-: DOM id prefix (template-literal interpolation `eve-factor-${id}`), not prose.
allowLiteral.msg-: DOM id prefix (template-literal interpolation `msg-${fromId}` / `msg-${toId}`), not prose.
allowLiteral.send-: DOM id prefix (template-literal interpolation `send-${fromId}-btn`), not prose.
allowLiteral.crt-toggle-: DOM id prefix (template-literal interpolation `crt-toggle-${toId}`), not prose.
allowLiteral.h = qInv·(m1 − m2) mod p =: Notation label built as a plain textContent assignment (lblH) — qInv is the one camelCase abbreviation in it (see allowSame rsa.lblHFormula); the rest is pure formula notation.

allowRenderText.qInv = q: Rendered fragment of rsa.lblQInv before its <sup>-1</sup> child — qInv is a camelCase abbreviation, not a natural-language word (dictionary-level allowSame mirrored here for the runtime langs check).
allowRenderText.h = qInv: Rendered fragment of rsa.lblHFormula's plain-textContent sibling label (lblH) before the next value — same qInv abbreviation.
allowRenderText.bit: 'bit' is spelled identically in Dutch, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese and European Portuguese — genuine cognate (dictionary-level allowSame mirrored here for the runtime langs check; Italian added by quick task 261002-c77, Polish added by quick task 261002-fmi, Brazilian and European Portuguese added by quick task 261002-jh4).
allowRenderText.expression: French 'expression' is spelled identically to English — genuine cognate (dictionary-level allowSame mirrored here for the runtime langs check).
allowRenderText.direct c: Rendered fragment of rsa.crtDirectVsLine before its <sup>d</sup> child — French 'direct' is spelled identically to English (dictionary-level allowSame mirrored here for the runtime langs check).
